recentItems.title: Shree Annadanishwara Mahatme Trailer | Abhijith Rao | Gowri L Ramegowda | V Manohar
recentItems.description:
Watch the Official Trailer of Shree Annadanishwara Mahatme, an upcoming Kannada devotional and biographical film based on the life of Sri Jagadguru Dr. Annadanishwara Mahaswamiji of Mundargi, Gadag district.

Featuring Abhijith Rao in the role of Annadanishwara Swamiji, the film portrays the life, spiritual legacy and contributions of the revered Jagadguru. The movie is directed by Gowri L. Ramegowda, produced by Mamatha N. S., and features music composed by renowned Kannada music director V. Manohar. Sanjay Kumar Bevinahal has written the screenplay, dialogues and lyrics.
